title: A combinatorial approach to uncover an additional Integrator subunit.
authors: Offley, Sarah R; Pfleiderer, Moritz M; Zucco, Avery; Fraudeau, Angelique; Welsh, Sarah A; Razew, Michal; Galej, Wojciech P; Gardini, Alessandro
one_liner_zh: 该文用蛋白质组学和AlphaFold2预测发现Integrator新亚基INTS15，虽涉及转录调控和结构预测，但核心是蛋白复合物组装而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: RNA polymerase II (RNAPII) controls expression of all protein-coding genes and most noncoding loci in higher eukaryotes. Calibrating RNAPII activity requires an assortment of polymerase-associated factors that are recruited at sites of active transcription. The Integrator complex is one of the most elusive transcriptional regulators in metazoans, deemed to be recruited after initiation to help establish and modulate paused RNAPII. Integrator is known to be composed of 14 subunits that assemble and operate in a modular fashion. We employed proteomics and machine-learning structure prediction (AlphaFold2) to identify an additional Integrator subunit, INTS15. We report that INTS15 assembles primarily with the INTS13/14/10 module and interfaces with the Int-PP2A module. Functional genomics analysis further reveals a role for INTS15 in modulating RNAPII pausing at a subset of genes. Our study shows that omics approaches combined with AlphaFold2-based predictions provide additional insights into the molecular architecture of large and dynamic multiprotein complexes.
abstract_zh: RNA聚合酶II（RNAPII）控制着高等真核生物中所有蛋白质编码基因及大多数非编码位点的表达。校准RNAPII活性需要多种聚合酶相关因子的参与，这些因子在活跃转录位点被招募。整合子复合物（Integrator complex）是后生动物中最难以捉摸的转录调控因子之一，被认为在转录起始后被招募，以帮助建立和调节暂停的RNAPII。已知整合子由14个亚基组成，这些亚基以模块化方式组装和运作。我们采用蛋白质组学和机器学习结构预测（AlphaFold2）技术，识别出一个额外的整合子亚基，即INTS15。我们报告，INTS15主要与INTS13/14/10模块组装，并与Int-PP2A模块相互作用。功能基因组学分析进一步揭示了INTS15在调节一组基因的RNAPII暂停中的作用。我们的研究表明，组学方法结合基于AlphaFold2的预测，为大型动态多蛋白复合物的分子架构提供了更多见解。
